goal: Determine who performed the route-export recorded on this terminal and whether the door badge scans can be attributed to a specific person; state exactly what each record set supports.
case_context: A seized dispatch terminal used at a delivery depot. The access directory holds door-badge scan records; the app directory holds the dispatch console's action log. The two record sets are from different systems and share no identifier fields.

charter.text: Which account performed the route-export action recorded in the dispatch console log, and what exactly do the records support about attributing that action?
Are the door badge scans internally consistent, and can any individual be attributed as the badge holder? State exactly what the records support.
